title: Studio Automations: on a read-only package, clicking a flow canvas node opens no inspector, so packaged flows' node configuration cannot be read (moved from objectstack-ai/objectstack#21575)
body:
Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`). It moves objectstack-ai/objectstack#21575 here, where the fix lands. That card was filed by objectstack's `domain:services` seat 2 from the objectstack-ai/objectstack#12438 acceptance run. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Graded here: `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue`.

## Measured (objectstack `main` `a3873542ca`, console built at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `89cad75d5570`, stock showcase)

- In Studio → Automations on a **read-only** package (`com.example.showcase`), clicking any node on a flow canvas opens **no inspector**. The panel keeps its empty state.
- It reproduced with two click methods, in two fresh browser contexts, across 30/30 showcase flows.
- **Positive control:** the same click on an editable canvas (the Setup metadata-admin designer) opens the node inspector.

## Why

objectui#11124 fixed the earlier read-only defect, where the inspector opened with editable inputs. Its comment in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` promises that "node and edge selection still open the inspector read-only below". Selection now opens nothing, so an administrator cannot read a packaged flow's node configuration in Studio.

## Where (read at `origin/main`)

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/FlowCanvas.tsx`:
- `onNodePointerDown` (about `:408`) returns early when the canvas is not editable, before `e.stopPropagation()`;
- the background's `onBgPointerDown` (about `:457`) then clears the selection.

## Ruling

- On a read-only canvas a node click selects. Only the drag is withheld. The selection then opens the inspector read-only, as objectui#11124 promised.
- ⛔ No editable input appears. That would bring back objectui#11124's defect.
- **Pins:**
  - a read-only canvas: a node click opens the read-only inspector;
  - the editable designer: drag and select as before;
  - objectui#11124's read-only-inputs pin stays green.

**Why p3.** A read surface is missing. Nothing is written and no lock is breached.

**Not this card:** objectstack-ai/objectstack#21332 (a cloned flow reaches no Studio surface), which is a different mechanism.
